info.name: Recast Backend API
info.description:
Curated collection for the Recast SaaS backend — grouped by feature, with realistic example payloads and example responses for manual testing.

Set `base_url` as a collection variable (defaults to http://localhost:8000). Run Auth → Signup or Login once — their test script auto-saves access_token/refresh_token into collection variables, so every other request picks them up automatically via Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}. Workspace-scoped routes also read X-Workspace-Id: {{workspace_id}} — set that manually after creating/listing a workspace, since which workspace to use is your call, not something a script can guess.
